shortDescription: Chinese food delivery company Meituan HKEX:3690 is offering 5- and 10-year offshore yuan bonds, or dim sum bonds, with initial price guidance of around 2.90% for the 5-year and 3.60% for the 10-year, according to a term sheet seen by Reuters.
